in_marathi.name: Bhuwan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhuwan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhuwan is a name derived from Sanskrit language, which means 'Lord of the Earth'. In Hindu mythology, Bhuwan is one of the seven celestial worlds in the universe, ruled by the deity Lord Vishnu. It is the earthly world, where humans reside.
